component: Mailbox URL interface and request-state scope

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The patch removes the scriptable nsIMailboxUrl interface and moves action constants to MailboxAction. The concrete nsMailboxUrl still stores its copy handler, action, message size/key and multi-message keys/index. Interface removal therefore does not establish that the native URL becomes stateless or serializable. This is a declaration/state finding, with no engine serialization or runtime result.
title: Removing nsIMailboxUrl leaves request state in the concrete mailbox URL
